source.place: Agent algebraic refinement supporting Proposition 14.50, printed p.296, and the homogeneous Frobenius-module prerequisite in the vector-group argument. This refinement is not stated in Milne; its independent argument is recorded in the delivery report. No Stacks tag is asserted. Generation argument: induction on the finite p-divisibility height of a nonzero integral lattice weight; excludes the zero-weight summand.

proof.text: Put $W=\operatorname{span}_k\{T^r(b_j):r\geq0,1\leq j\leq m\}$. It contains every $b_j$. For a finite expansion $w=\sum_{r,j}a_{rj}T^r(b_j)$, additivity and semilinearity give $T(w)=\sum_{r,j}\sigma(a_{rj})T^{r+1}(b_j)\in W$. Thus $T(W)\subseteq W$; this calculation does not require $\sigma$ to be onto.
